response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates strong experience in software development, distributed systems, and leadership through mentoring and organizing workshops. However, his background is heavily skewed toward web/mobile development, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Dlang, with limited focus on C++ and large-scale cloud infrastructure. His 8 years of C++ experience are not clearly highlighted in leadership-heavy or cloud compute contexts, which are critical for this role. His mentoring and technical leadership are evident but lack direct alignment with cloud compute platform requirements.
strengths: Extensive experience in software architecture and distributed systems (e.g., GISCollective, real-time micro-services at Dunnhumby)
Strong leadership and mentoring background (e.g., organizing workshops, training sessions, and code katas)
Demonstrated ability to deliver high-performance solutions (e.g., top 10 Apple TV app, low-latency apps at Dunnhumby)
concerns: Limited direct experience with C++ in large-scale infrastructure or cloud compute platforms (primary focus on JavaScript/TypeScript and Dlang)
Minimal evidence of working with cloud architecture or compute technologies (e.g., AWS, Kubernetes, or similar at scale)
Lack of explicit experience in technical leadership roles for cloud/DevOps teams or managing project priorities at scale

key_factors.factor: C++ experience in cloud compute infrastructure
Cloud architecture and distributed systems leadership
Technical mentoring and leadership in cloud/DevOps context
